videos.title: (Part 1) Color pencil drawing of "The Grinch Who Stole Christmas" with Jim Carrey
videos.description:
I love this movie and figured what better way to get into the Christmas spirit with none other than good ‘ol Jim Carrey. I thought he made the best Grinch and did a great job in the movie. Anyway, I hope you enjoy it as much as I did drawing him as the Grinch.

I used Prismacolor pencils and Ohuhu markers for this particular creation. 

Let me know what you thought in the comments. Please give me a like and subscribe if you liked this. I will be drawing many more like this one for all the holidays.
Merry Christmas & Happy Holidays!

After pondering for a while I wasn't completely satisfied with my first attempt so I decided to modify the original drawing to incorporate additional detail and shadowing to improve on its realism.

To see Part 2 of this video please go to:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lp_Dd7d04wI

The music "You're A Mean One, Mr. Grinch" is by Thurl Ravenscroft Listen ad-free with YouTube Red
